splits.train: global_splits.json:train; fit model and normalization only
splits.validation: global_splits.json:val; checkpoint selection and stopping only
splits.evaluation: global_splits.json:eval; locked until all arms and failure records freeze
splits.normalization: fit on train once per data manifest; reuse unchanged on val/eval and every arm

neural_diffusion_contract.bridge_correction: full a @ grad(log_h) in both state coordinates

evaluation.hdr90: segment endpoint membership in the model's 90% highest-density region; report coverage and abs(coverage-0.90)
evaluation.bootstrap: paired segment-level block bootstrap, B=2000, resample identical segment_id blocks for every contrast
evaluation.convergence: report converged flag, iterations/epochs, final objective, selected checkpoint and all numerical failures

bridge_dual.paths: same sampled paths for existence and exclusion
bridge_dual.event: one discrete per-path boolean hit event E; exclusion is the boolean complement not E
bridge_dual.reconstruction: raw full-support bin counts including underflow and overflow; sum_j abs(p_recon_j - p_prior_j) <= 1e-12
bridge_dual.strata: hit and non-hit strata must both be non-empty; otherwise record undefined_stratum and never pass
bridge_dual.fp_mc_l1: report analytic-prior versus Monte-Carlo sampling/discretization error separately; do not apply the algebraic 1e-12 tolerance

delta_probe.scope: one-dimensional position event only; a two-dimensional event requires a new preregistration
delta_probe.displacement: DeltaX_i = X_T_i - X_0_i on the train split after frozen position normalization
delta_probe.sigma_hist: 1.4826 * median_i(abs(DeltaX_i - median_j(DeltaX_j))); compute exactly once for the whole matrix
delta_probe.base_region: normalize preregistered A to a union of mutually disjoint closed intervals [l_j,r_j]
delta_probe.dilation: A_plus_delta = union [l_j-delta,r_j+delta], merge overlaps, intersect domain D
delta_probe.boundary: closed-set membership for every hit decision
delta_probe.failure: non-finite or zero sigma_hist, or empty eroded region, is probe failure/NA; never replace delta post hoc

reporting.capacity_scan: ordered trend with simultaneous 95% family-wise intervals; Holm-adjust the three adjacent contrasts within each model family
reporting.structure_contrast: one predeclared paired contrast I1-K10 minus neural-H8; separate Holm family from the two capacity scans
reporting.seeds: use and report only the registered seed 20260814; any diagnostic rerun is labeled non-confirmatory
reporting.failures: intention-to-run denominator; no metric imputation; report failure count and reason beside successful-run summaries
